name: Admin Panel
provenance: artifact names recovered from prior summary; original sandbox bytes were not persisted
hard_rules: permissions are enforced by backend authorization, never only by hidden UI controls
independent publication review requires reviewer != author/generator
all question/option/explanation edits create immutable revision/audit evidence
bulk mutations require preview plus explicit confirmation
bulk imports create DRAFT questions only
bulk status changes cannot produce APPROVED, PUBLISHED, REJECTED or RETIRED
every status mutation is validated against the Stage11 transition contract
APPROVED requires an independent reviewer and PUBLISHED requires an explicit publish batch
question retirement preserves historical attempts and snapshots
quality metrics are displayed with sample size

bulk_import_policy.server_behavior: reject any row whose requested status is not DRAFT; never coerce privileged states silently
bulk_import_policy.post_import_next_step: Stage11 machine validation and independent review

bulk_status_policy.transition_gate: validate every item against the Stage11 contract at config/stage11_workflow.json and fail the batch atomically
bulk_status_policy.approval_path: dedicated review action with reviewer != author/generator
bulk_status_policy.publication_path: explicit Stage11/12 publish batch after APPROVED

audit_contract.write_rule: Stage21 writes both records in one transaction; admin_audit_events supplements and never replaces Stage12 audit_logs

stage21: admin API implementation and backend authorization
stage22: admin UI components and responsive/accessibility behavior
stage23: full import pipeline and rollback semantics
stage24: permission, bulk and audit acceptance tests
stage25: security, retention and sensitive audit policy
